ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Shell/Scripting Processes Spawning Suspicious Programs
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious child processes of a Windows shell and scripting processes such as wscript, rundll32, powershell, mshta...etc.

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wmiprvse\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\nslookup\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT (process_working_directory = RGX(".*\\\\ccmcache\\\\.*") OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Amazon\\\\WorkSpacesConfig\\\\Scripts\\\\setup\\-scheduledtask\\\.ps1.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Amazon\\\\WorkSpacesConfig\\\\Scripts\\\\set\\-selfhealing\\\.ps1.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Amazon\\\\WorkSpacesConfig\\\\Scripts\\\\check\\-workspacehealth\\\.ps1.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\nessus\\_.*")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\nessus\\_.*") OR (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\MEM\\_Configmgr\\_.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\splash\\\.hta.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\{1E460BD7\\-F1C3\\-4B2E\\-88BF\\-4E770A288AF5\\}.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\MEM\\_Configmgr\\_.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SMSSETUP\\\\BIN\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\autorun\\\.hta.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\{1E460BD7\\-F1C3\\-4B2E\\-88BF\\-4E770A288AF5\\}.*"))))
